subject: Plot densities per facet on a faceted scatterplot

messages.author: 966da74af0ee5d18
messages.subject: Plot densities per facet on a faceted scatterplot
parts:
Hello,

I'm reading the ggplot2 book and training on an election dataset which is a dataframe with columns: id, attendance, party, votePercent.
I'm faceting it by party and drawing a scatterplot of vote percent vs. attendance.

I'd like to also add the density of attendance, preferably weighted by votes, to each of these facets, as a background layer.

I'm trying something like this:
ggplot(data=msk, aes(Attendance, VotePercent)) + geom_histogram(aes(y=..density..), alpha=I(1/2)) + geom_point(shape=".") + facet_wrap(~ Party, ncol=3)

However I get the same density plot on all facets; apparently computed against the whole dataset.

How do I get per-facet densities? I've found a few questions about this on stackoverflow and in this group, and they seemed to suggest that this is impossible, and showed ways to achieve this for simpler statistics like mean, using ddply, but I can't figure out how to do this for non-scalar statistics like density histograms. Also, things could have changed since, and perhaps now ggplot2 supports this?...

Thanks.

(By the way, if this is still impossible, but if someone can give me a hint on where to look in the ggplot2 implementation to add this feature, or at least if the library authors think that it would be a good thing to have - I'd be happy to spend some time trying to implement it)
